name: Mindcircus
source:
A struggling med student named Inpu is barely scraping by, drinking way too much and feeling pretty down about life. Then, out of nowhere, he wins a trip abroad.

Just as he's starting to enjoy his vacation, he finds himself caught up in a mysterious string of murders. Can he solve the case and escape the island alive?

This visual novel is loosely inspired by a certain sci-fi novel and a certain adult visual novel. It includes some exploration and puzzle-solving elements.

Warning: Contains spoilers for a certain mystery novel (its title is mentioned in-game).

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17657]freem[/url]]
translation:
一名名叫因普 (Inpu) 的医学生苦苦挣扎，他酗酒，对生活感到十分沮丧，勉强度日。然后，他突然赢得了一次出国旅行的机会。

正当他开始享受假期时，他发现自己陷入了一系列神秘的谋杀案中。他能侦破案件并活着逃离岛屿吗？

这部视觉小说的灵感大致来自某部科幻小说和某部成人视觉小说。它包括一些探索和解谜元素。

警告：包含某部悬疑小说的剧透（其标题已在游戏中提及）。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17657]freem[/url]]
